boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented University of Mary rituals and recurring campus practices rooted in its Welcome Week, service, music, and faith life.

cards.title: Wheat Ceremony
cards.subtitle: Welcome Week admission ritual
cards.notes: Attend the president’s welcome to see new students formally welcomed and admitted alongside families, faculty, deans, and Marauders coaches.
cards.short_summary: A formal Welcome Week ritual dating to Mary’s earliest days.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Mary describes the Wheat Ceremony as an early-days tradition in which new students are formally welcomed and admitted to the university.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled as part of Welcome Week; consult the current Welcome Week schedule.

cards.title: New Students and Family Dinner
cards.subtitle: Welcome Week meal-sharing tradition
cards.notes: Join your family table during Welcome Week and use the meal as a low-pressure introduction to the wider Mary learning community.
cards.short_summary: A Welcome Week meal-sharing practice for new students and families.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Mary calls the New Students and Family Dinner a continuation of its Welcome Week traditions of sharing a meal.
cards.access_notes: The university states that the new student and two family members eat free; additional tickets may be purchased.

cards.title: Starlight Social
cards.subtitle: Welcome Week at the President’s Residence
cards.notes: Bring a layer for the outdoor Welcome Week social, where attendees gather around the fire pit, make s’mores, and dance under the stars.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor Welcome Week social hosted at the President’s Residence.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Mary lists Starlight Social among its Welcome Week traditions and describes it as a President’s Residence gathering with a fire pit, s’mores, and dancing.
cards.access_notes: Part of Welcome Week; timing and weather arrangements vary by the current schedule.

cards.entity_name: University of Mary Day of Service
cards.title: Day of Service
cards.subtitle: Community Learning Day in Bismarck–Mandan
cards.notes: Sign up for a service site, begin with the campus prayer service and convocation, then spend the day volunteering with your assigned group.
cards.short_summary: A student-developed campuswide day of volunteer service.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Mary says Day of Service was developed in 2014 as a tradition centered on Benedictine values, with students, faculty, and staff volunteering together.
cards.source_title: Day of Service | University of Mary
cards.access_notes: Service sites and transportation are organized for the event; follow current Mission for Life instructions.

cards.title: Prayer Day
cards.subtitle: Annual campus reflection gathering
cards.notes: Set aside the event window for the keynote and communal reflection; review the current program for speaker and location details.
cards.short_summary: A University of Mary faith-and-reflection tradition hosted for four decades.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Mary states that it has hosted Prayer Day for four decades and that the event includes a faith-focused presentation organized by University Ministry.
cards.access_notes: Program details change annually; use the university event page for the current offering.

cards.title: Jazz Festival
cards.subtitle: Annual Music Department festival
cards.notes: Watch the late-January program for participating-school performances and guest-artist events, then plan your visit around the posted festival schedule.
cards.short_summary: A jazz gathering founded in 1974 and maintained by the Music Department.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Mary says its Jazz Festival was founded in 1974 and has become an honored tradition for the Music Department and Bismarck–Mandan community.
cards.access_notes: Held annually at the end of January; confirm performance times and venues on the current festival page.

cards.title: Christmas at Mary
cards.subtitle: Annual Music Department concert
cards.notes: Look for the seasonal concert announcement and attend to hear University of Mary musicians perform a program featuring Christmas carols.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Mary identifies Christmas at Mary as an annual concert by its Music Department featuring Christmas carols.
cards.access_notes: Annual event; check the university calendar for the current date, venue, and admission details.

cards.entity_name: University of Mary March for Life Trip
cards.title: March for Life
cards.subtitle: Annual University Ministry trip
cards.notes: Contact University Ministry early if you want to learn about the university’s current delegation, preparation, travel, and participation requirements.
cards.short_summary: A recurring University of Mary delegation to the national March for Life.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Mary states that it sends students to the March for Life each year as a witness to the sanctity of human life.
cards.access_notes: This is an off-campus trip; confirm current registration, travel, and participation details with University Ministry.

cards.title: Vocations Jamboree
cards.subtitle: Annual gathering of religious and missionary communities
cards.notes: Browse the current Jamboree program, attend a session, and use the gathering to meet visiting religious communities and service organizations.
cards.short_summary: A recurring three-day campus gathering for discernment and encounter.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Mary describes its Vocations Jamboree as an annual three-day gathering that brings religious communities, missionary organizations, students, and clergy to campus.
cards.source_title: University of Mary to Host National Vocations Jamboree
cards.access_notes: Annual program dates and participants vary; consult the current university announcement or events calendar.

cards.title: Monday Morning Mission
cards.subtitle: Weekly University Ministry prayer service
cards.notes: Start the week by joining the University Ministry prayer service in the Starion Financial Living Room, then check current ministry updates for changes.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Mary states that its Christian community gathers weekly for Monday Morning Mission, a prayer service hosted by University Ministry.
cards.access_notes: The university identifies the Starion Financial Living Room in the lower level of the Lumen Vitae University Center; confirm the current time with University Ministry.
